spans.s:
उत् ind. An interjection of, 1. asking, (how, what?)
 2. of deliberation,
(either, or;)
 3. of extreme doubt, (hey! what!)
 4. Up, above, on,
upon; see उद्.

उद् or उत् ind. A particle and prefix to words implying, 1. Superiority
in degree; (over, above.)
 2. In place, (over, above, on, upon.)
3.
